quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Elena said, "I can't attend the meeting."
quests.reportedSpeech: Elena said that she couldn't attend the meeting.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Can't' becomes 'couldn't'; modals never take 'did' or 'didn't' in front of them.
quests.nativeTip: Negative modals shift too — 'can't' has a specific past form.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Elena said, "I can't attend the meeting."" ➔ "Elena said that she couldn't attend the meeting."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech
quests.directSpeech: The scientist said, "This method can produce faster results."
quests.reportedSpeech: The scientist said that that method could produce faster results.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Can' becomes 'could', and 'this' becomes 'that'.
quests.nativeTip: Combine the modal backshift with the demonstrative change.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The scientist said, "This method can produce faster results."" ➔ "The scientist said that that method could produce faster results."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: The witness said, "I can identify the man in the photo."
quests.reportedSpeech: The witness said that he could identify the man in the photo.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Can' becomes 'could', and 'identify' stays in its base form, not 'identified'.
quests.nativeTip: Remember to keep the base form of the verb after the modal.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The witness said, "I can identify the man in the photo."" ➔ "The witness said that he could identify the man in the photo."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: The forecaster said, "It may rain later this week."
quests.reportedSpeech: The forecaster said that it might rain later that week.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'May' becomes 'might', and 'this week' becomes 'that week'; the verb stays as 'rain'.
quests.nativeTip: Backshift the modal, adjust the time word, and keep the base verb form.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The forecaster said, "It may rain later this week."" ➔ "The forecaster said that it might rain later that week."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Diego said, "I may not be able to attend."
quests.reportedSpeech: Diego said that he might not be able to attend.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'May not' becomes 'might not', and 'I' becomes 'he'.
quests.nativeTip: Keep 'not' in its position after the modal, and the verb form after 'be able to' unchanged.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Diego said, "I may not be able to attend."" ➔ "Diego said that he might not be able to attend."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Mixed Reported Speech

quests.reportedSpeech: The manager said that sales might improve the following quarter.

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said, "Sales may improve next quarter."" ➔ "The manager said that sales might improve the following quarter."

quests.directSpeech: The CEO said, "This company will not fail."
quests.reportedSpeech: The CEO said that that company would not fail.

quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The CEO said, "This company will not fail."" ➔ "The CEO said that that company would not fail."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift

quests.reportedSpeech: Fatima said that she would definitely finish by Friday.

quests.nativeTip: Backshift the modal and update the pronoun; the base verb stays the same.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Fatima said, "I will definitely finish by Friday."" ➔ "Fatima said that she would definitely finish by Friday."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: The airline said, "Passengers will receive a full refund."
quests.reportedSpeech: The airline said that passengers would receive a full refund.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Will' backshifts to 'would'; no pronoun or possessive needs to change.
quests.nativeTip: No pronoun changes here — just backshift the modal.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The airline said, "Passengers will receive a full refund."" ➔ "The airline said that passengers would receive a full refund."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: The manager said, "You must complete this training by Friday."
quests.reportedSpeech: The manager said that I had to complete that training by Friday.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Must' (obligation for this occasion) becomes 'had to', 'you' becomes 'I', and 'this' becomes 'that'.
quests.nativeTip: This 'must' expresses a specific obligation, so it backshifts to 'had to'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The manager said, "You must complete this training by Friday."" ➔ "The manager said that I had to complete that training by Friday."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Backshift Exception
quests.directSpeech: Emeka said, "She must be exhausted after that flight."
quests.reportedSpeech: Emeka said that she must be exhausted after that flight.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Must' expressing certainty/deduction doesn't backshift to 'had to'; it stays as 'must' in reported speech.
quests.nativeTip: This 'must' expresses a logical conclusion, not an obligation — such modals of deduction usually stay the same.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Emeka said, "She must be exhausted after that flight."" ➔ "Emeka said that she must be exhausted after that flight."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: The sign said, "Visitors must wear a badge at all times."
quests.reportedSpeech: The sign said that visitors had to wear a badge at all times.
quests.ruleExplanation: This 'must' expresses an obligation or rule, so it backshifts to 'had to', unlike a 'must' of deduction.
quests.nativeTip: Compare this to the deduction example — this 'must' expresses a rule, so it does backshift.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The sign said, "Visitors must wear a badge at all times."" ➔ "The sign said that visitors had to wear a badge at all times."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: The waiter asked, "Shall I bring the menu?"
quests.reportedSpeech: The waiter asked whether he should bring the menu.
changesList: question word order → statement word order
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Shall I...?' as an offer becomes 'should he', and 'I' becomes 'he'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Shall' in offers or suggestions usually becomes 'should' in reported speech.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The waiter asked, "Shall I bring the menu?"" ➔ "The waiter asked whether he should bring the menu."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Modal Backshift
quests.directSpeech: Grace said, "I shall return within the hour."
quests.reportedSpeech: Grace said that she would return within the hour.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Shall' (future intention) becomes 'would', while 'should' would only be used for suggestions.
quests.nativeTip: 'Shall' used for future intention becomes 'would', not 'should'.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "Grace said, "I shall return within the hour."" ➔ "Grace said that she would return within the hour."

quests.nativeTip: Combine the suggestion-modal change with the pronoun shift.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The teacher asked, "Shall we begin the lesson?"" ➔ "The teacher asked whether they should begin the lesson."

quests.conceptTitle: Speech Bubble to Report Converter: Backshift Exception

quests.ruleExplanation: 'Should' does not backshift further; it remains 'should' even in reported speech, unlike 'will' or 'can'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Should' already functions as a past-time-compatible modal — it usually stays the same in reported speech.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The advisor said, "You should diversify your investments."" ➔ "The advisor said that I should diversify my investments."

quests.nativeTip: 'Ought to' behaves like 'should' — it doesn't change to a different modal.
quests.backshiftSummary: 🔄 Quote ➔ Report: "The mechanic said, "This part ought to last for years."" ➔ "The mechanic said that that part ought to last for years."
